meta.case: B0: N=0 reproduces Milestone A's widom exactly
meta.test_item: test/nvt_tests.jl::N=0 reproduces Milestone A's widom exactly (to floating-point rounding)
meta.note: Not bit-for-bit: cycle-based blocking (this milestone's run_nvt!) groups samples differently from Milestone A's insertion-based blocking (widom_singlephase), so the two estimators sum the same per-insertion Boltzmann weights in the same order into differently-shaped block partitions. Their totals therefore agree to floating-point rounding (rtol 1e-10) rather than bit for bit -- the same standard this project already applies to other independently-grouped floating-point sums (moves_tests.jl's GPU-vs-CPU comparison).
meta.verified_after: the energy-audit tolerance fix (item 1, commit f6a99ca)
